import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def aggregate_window(df: pd.DataFrame, mask: pd.Series, suffix: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    window_df = df[mask].copy()
    order_product = window_df[
        ["product_id", "order_id", "is_delivered", "is_cancelled",
         "review_score", "delivery_early_days", "total_payment",
         "avg_installments", "num_payments"]
    ].drop_duplicates()
    line_item_agg = window_df.groupby("product_id").agg(
        num_items=("order_id", "count"),
        total_revenue=("item_total_value", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        med_price=("price", "median"),
        max_price=("price", "max"),
        min_price=("price", "min"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        med_freight=("freight_value", "median"),
        max_freight=("freight_value", "max"),
        avg_item_total=("item_total_value", "mean"),
    ).reset_index()
    order_agg = order_product.groupby("product_id").agg(
        num_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        pct_delivered=("is_delivered", "mean"),
        num_delivered=("is_delivered", "sum"),
        pct_cancelled=("is_cancelled", "mean"),
        num_cancelled=("is_cancelled", "sum"),
        avg_review=("review_score", "mean"),
        num_reviews=("review_score", "count"),
        avg_delivery_early=("delivery_early_days", "mean"),
        avg_total_payment=("total_payment", "mean"),
        avg_installments=("avg_installments", "mean"),
        avg_num_payments=("num_payments", "mean"),
    ).reset_index()
    agg = pd.merge(line_item_agg, order_agg, on="product_id", how="outer")
    agg["avg_items_per_order"] = agg["num_items"] / agg["num_orders"]
    agg.columns = [
        "product_id" if col == "product_id" else f"{col}{suffix}"
        for col in agg.columns
    ]
    return agg

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders_df = db["orders"]
    order_items_df = db["order_items"]
    reviews_df = db["reviews"]
    payments_df = db["payments"]

    # Только заказы, сделанные до seed_time
    historical_items = order_items_df[order_items_df["ts"] <= seed_time].copy()

    # Информация о статусе/датах: учитываем только то, что уже произошло к seed_time
    orders_f = orders_df[
        orders_df["order_purchase_timestamp"] <= seed_time
    ][["order_id", "order_delivered_carrier_date",
       "order_delivered_customer_date", "order_estimated_delivery_date"]].copy()

    items_with_orders = pd.merge(
        historical_items,
        orders_f,
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )

    # Отзывы: учитываем только те, что уже созданы к seed_time
    reviews_f = reviews_df[
        reviews_df["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time
    ][["order_id", "review_score"]].drop_duplicates(subset=["order_id"], keep="last")

    items_with_reviews = pd.merge(
        items_with_orders,
        reviews_f,
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )

    # Платежи привязаны к моменту покупки (ts), считаем доступными
    payments_agg = payments_df.groupby("order_id").agg(
        total_payment=("payment_value", "sum"),
        num_payments=("payment_sequential", "count"),
        avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
    ).reset_index()

    items_full = pd.merge(
        items_with_reviews,
        payments_agg,
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )

    items_full["item_total_value"] = items_full["price"] + items_full["freight_value"]

    # Статусы: только события, произошедшие до seed_time
    delivered_before = items_full["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna() & \
        (items_full["order_delivered_customer_date"] <= seed_time)
    shipped_before = items_full["order_delivered_carrier_date"].notna() & \
        (items_full["order_delivered_carrier_date"] <= seed_time)

    items_full["is_delivered"] = delivered_before.astype(int)
    items_full["is_cancelled"] = 0  # факт отмены на момент покупки неизвестен достоверно
    # отмена известна, если покупки уже нет в статусе -- не можем знать; оставляем 0
    items_full.loc[~delivered_before & ~shipped_before, "is_cancelled"] = 0

    # Скорость доставки считается только для доставленных до seed_time
    items_full["delivery_early_days"] = np.nan
    est = items_full["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
    items_full.loc[delivered_before, "delivery_early_days"] = (
        (est[delivered_before] - items_full.loc[delivered_before, "order_delivered_customer_date"])
        .dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    )

    items_full["days_since_purchase"] = (
        seed_time - items_full["ts"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)

    masks = {
        "_7d": items_full["days_since_purchase"] <= 7,
        "_30d": items_full["days_since_purchase"] <= 30,
        "_90d": items_full["days_since_purchase"] <= 90,
        "_180d": items_full["days_since_purchase"] <= 180,
        "_all": pd.Series(True, index=items_full.index),
    }
    agg_dfs = [aggregate_window(items_full, mask, suffix) for suffix, mask in masks.items()]

    last_purchase = historical_items.groupby("product_id")["ts"].max().reset_index()
    last_purchase.columns = ["product_id", "last_order_ts"]
    last_purchase["days_since_last_purchase"] = (
        seed_time - last_purchase["last_order_ts"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)

    first_purchase = historical_items.groupby("product_id")["ts"].min().reset_index()
    first_purchase.columns = ["product_id", "first_order_ts"]
    first_purchase["days_on_sale"] = (
        seed_time - first_purchase["first_order_ts"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)

    sellers_per_product = historical_items.groupby("product_id")["seller_id"].nunique().reset_index()
    sellers_per_product.columns = ["product_id", "num_unique_sellers"]

    # Динамика продаж: число продаж в двух соседних окнах (момент времени = seed_time)
    items_full["month_bin"] = (items_full["ts"].dt.year * 12 + items_full["ts"].dt.month)
    current_bin = (seed_time.year * 12 + seed_time.month)
    items_full["bin_idx"] = ((current_bin - items_full["month_bin"]) // 3).astype(int)
    recent = items_full[items_full["bin_idx"].isin([0, 1, 2, 3])]
    trend = recent.pivot_table(
        index="product_id", columns="bin_idx", values="order_id", aggfunc="count"
    ).reindex(columns=[3, 2, 1, 0]).fillna(0)
    trend.columns = ["sales_bin_3", "sales_bin_2", "sales_bin_1", "sales_bin_0"]
    trend = trend.reset_index()
    trend["sales_trend"] = trend["sales_bin_0"] - trend["sales_bin_1"]
    trend["sales_trend_rel"] = np.where(
        trend["sales_bin_1"] > 0,
        trend["sales_bin_0"] / trend["sales_bin_1"],
        -1.0
    )

    global_features = last_purchase.merge(first_purchase, on="product_id", how="outer")
    global_features = global_features.merge(sellers_per_product, on="product_id", how="outer")
    global_features = global_features.merge(trend, on="product_id", how="outer")

    base = pd.DataFrame({"product_id": list(entity_ids)})
    features = pd.merge(base, global_features, on="product_id", how="left")
    for agg_df in agg_dfs:
        features = pd.merge(features, agg_df, on="product_id", how="left")

    features["has_any_sales"] = (~features["days_since_last_purchase"].isna()).astype(int)

    features = features.drop(columns=["last_order_ts", "first_order_ts"], errors="ignore")

    features["days_since_last_purchase"] = features["days_since_last_purchase"].fillna(9999)
    features["days_on_sale"] = features["days_on_sale"].fillna(-1)
    features["num_unique_sellers"] = features["num_unique_sellers"].fillna(0)
    trend_cols = ["sales_bin_0", "sales_bin_1", "sales_bin_2", "sales_bin_3",
                  "sales_trend", "sales_trend_rel"]
    features[trend_cols] = features[trend_cols].fillna(0)

    count_cols = [col for col in features.columns
                  if col.startswith("num_") or col.startswith("total_")
                  or col in trend_cols]
    non_stat_cols = {"product_id", "days_since_last_purchase", "days_on_sale",
                     "num_unique_sellers", "has_any_sales"}
    stat_cols = [col for col in features.columns
                 if col not in non_stat_cols and col not in count_cols]

    features[count_cols] = features[count_cols].fillna(0)
    features[stat_cols] = features[stat_cols].fillna(-1)

    features = features.set_index("product_id")
    features = features.reindex(list(entity_ids))
    return features
